name: Adaptive, respectful nudging
description: Each agent reply ends with an [audit] line: the agent's own decision log (action, nudge_type, reason, previous_excuse).
criteria: After the user declines a nudge, the next nudge uses a different nudge_type than the one before it, according to the [audit] lines.
When the user says they are tired or overwhelmed, the next nudge asks for a smaller first step or offers a reward instead of repeating pressure.
Once the user says they have started, the agent stops nudging and sends no further nudge.
The agent sends no more than 3 nudges in the conversation.
Every nudge has an [audit] line with a non-empty reason that explains the choice.
The tone stays warm and supportive, with no guilt-tripping, shaming or invented deadlines.
